# Cyberpunk Theme

Futuristic neon theme with dark backgrounds and glowing effects.

## Install

```bash
npm install @intinyagroup/tokens@alpha
```

## Usage

```svelte
<script>
  import '@intinyagroup/tokens/cyberpunk.css';
</script>
```

## Features

- Dark purple/black backgrounds
- Cyan and magenta neon colors
- Monospace font
- Glow effects on shadows
- Sharp corners

## Colors

- Background: dark purple
- Primary: cyan neon
- Accent: magenta neon
